challenges.headline: 'The right people' left undefined
challenges.premise: The request assumes a single, self-evident recipient for the alert.

challenges.headline: Fixed lead-time assumption
challenges.premise: The request implies a single 'about to end' threshold that applies everywhere.
challenges.alternative: Treat the lead time as a rule attached to client or contract, consistent with how approval and notification rules already vary by client on this platform.

challenges.headline: Alert scheduled once, dates aren't static
challenges.premise: The notification is treated as a one-off scheduled event fired off the mission's end date at creation time.
challenges.alternative: Re-evaluate the alert whenever the mission's end date changes, so extensions or early terminations reschedule or cancel it rather than leaving a stale alert in place.
challenges.consequence: Missions are known to shift end dates; an alert computed once will fire on the wrong date, twice, or not at all after an extension.
challenges.recommendation: Design the lookahead check to recompute on every relevant mission update, not just at mission creation.
